# agent/unpinned-mcp-server

MCP server without a pinned version.

MCP servers started with `npx -y <pkg>` or `@latest` without an exact version, `uvx <pkg>` without a version, container images without a tag, or remote MCP URLs over plain http on non-local hosts.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-494](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/494.html), [CWE-1357](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1357.html), OWASP A03:2025, OWASP ASI04.

## Why it matters

An unpinned server is code that updates itself on the next start, with access to the tokens and files the agent can reach. A compromised release reaches every developer at once, without a change in the repository.

## Flagged

`.codex/config.toml` (warn):

```toml
command = "npx"
```

`.cursor/mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"command": "npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp"
```

`.mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"command": "npx",
```

`.mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"command": "uvx",
```

`.mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"command": "docker",
```

`.mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"url": "http://mcp.example.com/sse"
```

`.mcp.json` (warn):

```json
"command": "pnpm",
```

## Not flagged

- `command = "npx"` in `.codex/config.toml`: exact version
- `"command": "npx --no-install ubon mcp"` in `.cursor/mcp.json`: uses the installed package, nothing is downloaded
- `"command": "npx",` in `.mcp.json`: exact version
- `"command": "uvx",` in `.mcp.json`: exact version
- `"command": "docker",` in `.mcp.json`: tagged image
- `"url": "http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp"` in `.mcp.json`: a server on this machine
- `"command": "node",` in `.mcp.json`: a script in the repository
- `"command": "npx",` in `.mcp.json`: a devDependency in package.json, so npx runs the installed version from the lockfile

## How to fix

Pin an exact version (pkg@1.2.3, pkg==1.2.3, image:1.2.3 or a digest) and update it deliberately.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore agent/unpinned-mcp-server: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "agent/unpinned-mcp-server": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
